objective: Replace turn-form speaker guessing with two closed nonverbal checks of the meaningful page-04/page-05 story transition.
narrative_check_contract: Check 1 uses machine_action SHOW_PAGE_SELECT_NEXT_SCENE, spoken_text null, semantic_task select_scene_of_next_story_page. Worked demonstrations: SHOW_PAGE_01 anchored to p01-t01 → scene-taro-ninereeds (page 02), and SHOW_PAGE_05 anchored to p05-t01 → scene-emma-ninereeds (page 06). Scored anchor is page 04/p04-t01; options are the two full scenes; expected next scene is scene-emma-ninereeds (page 05).

Check 2 uses machine_action SHOW_PAGE_SELECT_PREVIOUS_SCENE, spoken_text null, semantic_task select_scene_of_previous_story_page. Worked demonstrations: SHOW_PAGE_03 anchored to p03-t01 → scene-taro-ninereeds (page 02), and SHOW_PAGE_07 anchored to p07-t01 → scene-emma-ninereeds (page 06). Scored anchor is page 05/p05-t01; options are the two full scenes; expected previous scene is scene-taro-ninereeds (page 04).
Every demonstration uses SHOW_CORRECT_OPTION and its correct option ID belongs to the check's declared options.
The checks test the decisive Taro-to-Emma story transition. No replayed learner-language phrase, speaker name, response morphology, or portrait order reveals the answer.
State the evidentiary limit: success proves memory/comprehension of this accepted page sequence only, not general temporal language, biography, acquaintance, or identity mastery.
direct_application_contract: Preserve one separately typed learner-self check: Who are you? → I'm Ninereeds.; it is not narrative evidence.
